operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Section 7 of EO 11256 of November 4, 1965 (30 FR 14137, held Federal Register text) is headed Revocation of orders and states that Executive Order 10472 of July 20, 1953 and Executive Order 10937 of May 3, 1961 "are hereby revoked." EO 11256 contains no deferred effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1965-11-04 (the held Federal Register copy prints the day of the month as an OCR error; the register signing date is November 4, 1965). The command in section 1 (establishes the National Agricultural Advisory Commission of eighteen members with terms and a President-designated chairman) therefore ended on 1965-11-04 by presidential express revocation. EO 10937 of May 3, 1961 restated section 1 (the dossier records it as an amendment of section 1; under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling an amendment does not end the clause). Its Federal Register copy is held only as a custody record, so it is not cited as a later event here; the reviewer should note that the substance of section 1 changed (membership size, party and farmer shares, term dates) and that this does not affect the end, which rests on the express revocation by EO 11256.

research_rationale:
EO 10472 (18 FR 4247, July 20, 1953; held official Federal Register text) established the National Agricultural Advisory Commission to advise the Secretary of Agriculture, with its membership and terms (section 1), its advisory duty and meetings (section 2) and a no-funds-pending-appropriation rule (section 3). EO 10937 of May 3, 1961 restated section 1 (an amendment, not an end; its Federal Register copy is held only as a custody record, so it is disclosed here but not cited as a source). EO 11256 of November 4, 1965 (30 FR 14137) revoked EO 10472 and EO 10937 in its section 7 and established a new Committee and Commission in the same order. Every clause therefore ended on 1965-11-04 and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14. The inventory is corrected because the machine span missed section 1 and the first part of section 2 (columns misordered in the held scan).
